notes: Single shared reviewed-answer corpus consumed by conformance/run.mjs (web and Action) and conformance/run_py.py (published skill). For every dns-engine fixture, legacy present/absent assertions remain active and expect.findings is a closed list: area, title, severity, action, and fixIncludes are asserted; every non-pass finding must declare a non-null fixIncludes. Optional exact detail and optional effort+value pairs are asserted only where declared. expect.score is the exact bucket + DKIM-state + gap + note object; a true null MX uses explicit null for the inbound-only MTA_STS, TLS_RPT, and DANE buckets. Surface-specific findings require surfaces plus a documented notApplicable reason for every omitted shipping surface. No expectation-regeneration mode exists. Non-dns-engine modes remain explicitly skipped with a reason.
